The problem this solution exists for
Fraud moves at event speed while defenses run batch; false positives burn good customers; investigations drown; regulators want the decision trail.
Our approach

We build the streaming decision hub: features at event time, models + policy layers with champion-challenger, network analytics for organized fraud, and decision replay that answers auditors in minutes.
Reference architecture

blocks.title: Governed lakehouse pipeline — Fraud & Financial Crime Decisioning

blocks.x: We engineer Fraud & Financial Crime Decisioning so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.
